title: Blake Snyder Beat Sheet: Infografía Educativa Estilo Anime Chibi para Estructura Narrativa
prompt: A cute Japanese chibi anime style educational infographic about story structure, titled "The Blake Snyder Beat Sheet". The layout is a flowchart with a numbered, S-shaped path from 1 to 15. Each point on the path has a small, round illustration featuring a chibi white-haired girl in a blue dress, explaining a story beat with visual metaphors (like a door, a rollercoaster, a tombstone, a monster). Each illustration is accompanied by a bold Japanese title and a short explanatory text. The background is a soft, textured beige paper. The color palette is soft and pastel, transitioning from light blues and greens to darker tones and finally to warm yellows.
